# RadioPad GitHub Copilot instructions

`CLAUDE.md` is the canonical instruction source for this repository. Read it before
working, along with any directory-scoped instructions such as `frontend/CLAUDE.md`.
The detailed Copilot rules live in `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md`.

Use the Agent OS workflow automatically for every task: select applicable skills and
specialists, plan non-trivial work, delegate independent PR-sized units when useful,
coordinate dependencies, and perform focused validation. Keep trivial changes inline,
make routine decisions autonomously, and ask only for genuine requirements,
authorization, or safety blockers.

This does not grant extra permissions or override user approval, repository rules,
security boundaries, protected Git operations, secrets policy, or the GitHub-Actions-only
policy for heavy validation.
